head_height.value: 32-36 mm (chin to crown), face must occupy 70-80% of the photograph

file_spec.value: JPG/JPEG, RGB (min 24-bit), max 5 MB, min 531 x 413 pixels (H x W)

clothing_restriction.value: Military, police uniforms, or camouflage clothing prohibited

expression_restriction.value: Neutral expression, mouth closed, eyes open and clearly visible

glasses_policy.value: Corrective lenses permitted if eyes are clearly visible with no glare/reflection; tinted glasses prohibited; colored/circle contact lenses prohibited

ears_visibility.value: Ears must be clearly visible; exception for microtia patients

face_visibility.value: Full face from forehead to chin and both edges must be clearly visible; eyebrows, eyes, nose, mouth, face, ears must be shown

headwear_policy.value: No hats or head coverings except for religious or medical reasons

accessories.value: Natural moles, birthmarks, scars must be visible; colored/circle contact lenses prohibited

size.evidence: Official BOCA visa page (https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-158-250-a5a40-2.html) states: 'Two passport-size (45 mm in height and 35 mm in width) photos in color within 6 months.' Taiwan visa photos use the same 35x45mm specification as passport photos. This matches the claimed 3.5 x 4.5 cm (35 x 45 mm).
